area: storm wind / damage / closure physics -- VERIFIED
use_for_bot: Keep the fitter's formulas and k/sigma (identical below). Corrections concern reported claims, not the fair-value formula.

wind_field.formula: w = intensity * exp(-(d/radius)^2) if d < 2*radius else 0
wind_field.evidence: PORT: damage>0 iff min d/r < 2 over the 2-s obs (931 storms, no exceptions); free exponent fit b=1.993; Gaussian beats exp(-q), Rankine, modified Rankine, (1-q/2)^p and peak-wind models (see report table)

closure.rule: site closed (hurricane conditions) while w_site >= 0.35; island impact = first second any company site on the island has w >= 0.35
closure.independent_check: train-only scan 0.345..0.355: best at 0.350 (train timing exact 0.828, holdout 0.806, within 1 s 0.987/0.988, holdout yes/no agreement 0.99917)

damage.hazard: H_s = sum over 2-s storm obs of 2 * w_s(t)   (wind-seconds; equivalent to 1-s integration)
damage.site_fraction: f_s = 1 - exp(-k_c * m * H_s) of the site's REMAINING value
damage.noise: log m ~ N(0, sigma_c^2), one m per company per storm, shared by the company's sites, independent across companies, storms and rounds
damage.company_damage_pct: D_c = 100 * sum_s weight_s * rem_s * f_s ; rem_s = prod over earlier storms (1 - f_s)

optional_production_refit_all_600_season.note: Refit after validation on all 600 seasons (censored MLE). Differs from the train fit by <1% in k (FERRY +1.0%), within 1 SE; holdout point accuracy is unchanged by sigma choice. Optional.

sigma_pooled_all_companies.note: company sigmas are statistically indistinguishable; pooled sigma gives identical holdout RMSE

insured_loss.formula: industry_loss_musd = sum_c loss_per_pt[c] * damage_pct[c]  (exact; train/holdout R2 0.99999997, RMSE 0.044 = report rounding)
insured_loss.season_loss: season_loss_musd = sum of the 3 storm losses (max abs diff 0.1)

prelim_report.model: log(prelim/final) ~ N(0, s^2), independent of the final (cov(u_prelim,u_final)/var(u_final) = 0.93..1.06)
prelim_report.note: fitter's 0.302 was estimated on all 600 seasons (minor holdout leakage); train-only 0.3003 gives the same holdout posterior RMSE

storm_dynamics.intensity_mean_reversion: inc = 0.0143 - 0.0117*I per 2 s (level ~1.22, half-life ~119 s); level differs by pattern

corrections: 80% PI coverage 82-89% is inflated by zero-hazard company-storms (always trivially covered). Among company-storms with hazard > 0 (holdout): PORT 0.790, ISLE 0.819, AQUA 0.835, GRID 0.843, FERRY 0.818 -- calibrated.

'51% of damage locked in by age 300' is a share of unweighted damage POINTS summed over companies. Weighted by insured $ (what HAVEN/REIN care about) the share is 0.164/0.370/0.588/0.707/0.814/0.898/0.956/0.986 at ages 240/300/340/360/380/400/420/440. PORT alone: 0.01/0.10/0.35/0.53/0.69/0.83/0.93/0.98.
prelim_log_sd and the 0.35 threshold were estimated using all 600 seasons; re-estimated on 1-400 they are 0.3003 and 0.350 -- no material effect.
AQUA saturations (8 right-censored train cases) are all sites with remaining value ~0 after earlier storms or one extreme multiplier (s35 r2); no evidence of a damage cap or fleet sheltering.

independent_holdout_metrics.house_price_leak_test: house consensus change between real 532 s and 568 s has zero loading on (final - E[D]) (|coef| <= 0.005 $/pt, R2 <= 0.002): the multiplier m is not revealed before the prelim
